intro: A Witchwing Talon is a severed claw taken from the aggressive harpies inhabiting the northwestern canyons of the Barrens. Collected as bloody proof of dead raiders, they are sought by Horde scouts at the Crossroads trying to secure vital caravan routes.

p: The Witchwing harpies roost in the crags and ravines northwest of the Crossroads, routinely swooping down to pillage Horde supply caravans traversing the arid plains. To counter this threat, the scout Darsok Swiftdagger coordinates strikes against the flock's hierarchy. Rather than relying on simple reports, Darsok demands physical proof of every dead scavenger. Collecting these razor-sharp talons serves as concrete evidence that a marauder's throat has been cut, chipping away at the harpy rank and file before scouts dare strike higher up the chain of command.
